newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INCO says capex to rise in 1997.
newsitem.headline: INCO says capex to rise in 1997.

text.p: PT International Nickel Indonesia (INCO) said on Tuesday that 1997 capital expenditure was expected to be about $289 million, compared to $178 million in 1996 and $63 million in 1995.

The company said in a statement after a shareholders' meeting that there were significant capital expenditure requirements this year as a result of the $580 million expansion of its plant in Soroako on Sulawesi island.

It said of the $289 million to be spent this year, some $245 million was expected to relate to the expansion, which would result in a 50 percent increase to its production capacity of the current 100 million pounds of nickel in matte per year.

"The company had a solid financial year despite the fact that 1996 earnings of $61 million were below 1995 earnings of $96 million," INCO president and chief executive Rumengan Musu was quoted as telling shareholders.
He said that 1996 results were affected primarily by lower world nickel prices and higher income taxes and that the company viewed 1997 "with optimism".
